title: Insure residential building work (home warranty)
what: As a residential builder, carry out prescribed residential building work only while an authorised residential building insurance policy or a fidelity certificate is in force for the work, and give the policy document or certificate to the other party to the contract.

laws.title: Building Act 1993 (NT)
laws.provisions: section headed 'Requirement for authorised RBI policy or fidelity certificate', (1)

sources.title: Building Act 1993 (NT)
sources.locator: section headed 'Requirement for authorised RBI policy or fidelity certificate', (1) (current reprint)
sources.quote: A residential builder must not carry out prescribed residential building work unless: (a) (b) one of the following is in force for the work: (i) an authorised RBI policy; (ii) a fidelity certificate
